honesty: The game launched 19 November 2026 — the day this guide was written. No walkthrough has had time to verify every location and step, so this guide never invents one: where a location is not pinned down by a published source, the guide says so and points at the sources that will report it first. Every specific number in this guide comes from the official trophy descriptions or the progress targets PlayStation tracks, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles.

missableWarning.note: No trophy on the official list is confirmed permanently missable. The 19 below are tied to single story moments — chapters, missions, stranger strands, and one meditation spot — so earn them on your first run. Early guides report GTA VI has no mission replay and no New Game Plus; that claim is unconfirmed, so the cheap insurance is a manual save at the start of every chapter and one before the final mission.

roadmap.goal: Finish the story, and bank every story-moment trophy on the way. Do the stranger strands as you meet them, meditate at every spot you find, and keep a manual save at the start of each chapter.
roadmap.includes: Chapters 1–4, the final mission, all 7 named story missions, the 5 stranger strands with their own trophies, and the 8-strand silver.
roadmap.title: Stage 1 — The story

roadmap.goal: Try everything once. Sample all 9 activity types, gold the shooting range, win races at every Top Fun location, and clear the robbery and partner trophies while the story is fresh.
roadmap.includes: Shooting Range (42 golds), Top Fun (14 wins), 20 race wins, bank vaults, armored trucks, jewelry store, VCIA departure, Combat Focus, and the partner trophies.
roadmap.title: Stage 2 — Activities and side content

roadmap.goal: Work the long counters in free roam: 250 stunts, 100 vehicles, 100 WAiNK locations, 3 card sets, 52 areas, 9 gangs' operations, 50 challenges, and the money counters. Explore with a purpose — every area you visit feeds two or three trophies at once.
roadmap.includes: Stunts, vehicles, WAiNK, cards, exploration, gangs, challenges, laundering, spending, garages, Scooter Bros registrations.
roadmap.title: Stage 3 — Collectibles and counters

roadmap.goal: Finish the 100% completion checklist for the gold, then watch the platinum pop. Whatever is left — a challenge here, a card set there — is cleanup, and this guide's tracker shows exactly what remains.
roadmap.title: Stage 4 — Cleanup and the platinum

timeNote: Early coverage puts the platinum at roughly 200 hours. There is no difficulty trophy and no mission-medal requirement on this list — it is long, not hard.
